title: Population tier
description: A population tier. Houses of one tier upgrade in place to the next. One file per tier in content/tiers/<id>.json.

order.description: The tier's rank, 1 for the lowest; unique across tiers.

advanceFrom.description: The tier a house advances from to reach this one; leave out for the lowest tier.

upgradeCost.description: The cost of advancing a house into this tier.

basicNeeds.description: Needs a house must meet to stay at this tier.

services.description: Services a building must provide within road range.

comfortNeeds.description: Goods per 1,000 residents per day that raise this tier's output when met.

start.description: Whether the tier is available from the start without an unlockTier effect.
